output_audit.text_recurrence_metric: For each lowercased content string, tokenize words and punctuation; repeated 8-gram occurrence share = (all sliding 8-gram occurrences - number of unique 8-grams) / all occurrences. This is a text recurrence diagnostic, not a model-token usage percentage.
